channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: British Pound: Rally may stall near 1.3555 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights GBP/USD’s volatile session, with a spike from 1.3401 to 1.3481 and scope for further gains toward 1.3520, though overbought conditions may cap upside.

item.title: Iran's Baghaei: No talks with US currently regarding Hormuz
item.description: Remarks from Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson, Esmail Baghaei, released during the European trading session on Monday, indicate that Tehran is in no discussions with the United States (US) regarding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, a critical chokepoint for almost 20% of global energy supp

item.title: Oil: Red sea disruptions reshape global flows – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale analysts Michael Haigh and Jeremy Sellem describe how Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab security risks are forcing Oil cargoes onto longer, more complex routes.

item.title: US Dollar Index: Fed hike expectations support DXY – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes that despite sizeable joint FX intervention in USD/JPY and lower Oil prices, the US Dollar (USD) is not broadly weaker as markets still price a Federal Reserve (Fed) hike in September.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Faces rejection near 100-day SMA at 0.7050; bullish bias intact
item.description: The AUD/USD pair faces rejection near the 100-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) and retreats slightly after hitting a fresh high since June 17, around the 0.7050 level earlier this Monday.

item.title: Equities: Sector rotations shape summer performance – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes that equity indices have been broadly unchanged over the summer, but sector rotations have been significant. Higher Oil prices supported energy stocks, while within technology, software has outperformed and semiconductors have lagged.

item.title: Swiss Franc declines against US Dollar amid hawkish Fed bets
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) trades lower against its major currency peers at the start of the week. The USD/CHF pair rises 0.15% to near 0.8082 as a market-sentiment revival following the announcement of a ceasefire in the Middle East has diminished the appeal of safe-haven assets.

item.title: Indian Rupee gains as market applauses second US-Iran peace effort
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens strongly against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR extends its losing streak for the third trading day, is down 0.25% to near 95.15, the lowest level seen in over three weeks.

item.title: Forex Today: Mood improves as US and Iran renew push for diplomatic solution
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Monday, August 3:

item.title: Japanese Yen: Joint intervention signals potential turning point – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Michael Wan highlights that the Japanese Yen (JPY) has strengthened sharply, with USD/JPY dropping from around 164 after suspected intervention by Japan’s Ministry of Finance (MoF) and confirmed joint action with the US Treasury.

item.title: Canadian Dollar weakens on falling oil prices amid US-Iran talk hopes
item.description: The USD/CAD pair gathers strength to near 1.4030 during the early European session on Monday. A fall in crude oil prices weighs on the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) against the US Dollar (USD). The US ISM Manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) data will be released later on Monday.

item.title: Gold extends range play below $4,100 as rebounding USD meets receding Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on a modest weekly bullish gap opening and remains below the $4,100 mark heading into the European session. The US Dollar (USD) stages a modest recovery from its lowest level since June 17, which, in turn, is seen capping the upside for the commodity.

item.title: Oil: Prices slide on halted strikes – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s FX Research team reports that Brent Oil opened over 7% lower under USD84 into the Asian session after President Trump said the US would hold off on new strikes against Iran.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: At make or a break around 1.3500
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) underperforms its major currency peers, trading 0.1% lower at around 1.3470 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Monday.

item.title: Euro: Rebound eyes key resistance band against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang observes EUR/USD rebounded sharply after a dip to 1.1453, with scope to extend gains toward 1.1565 intraday, provided it holds above 1.1495.

item.title: Germany’s Retail Sales fall by 1.1% MoM in June vs. -0.5% expected
item.description: German Retail Sales, a key measure of consumer spending, showed a downside in June. The consumer spending measure fell 1.1% month-on-month (MoM), according to official data released by Destatis, while it was expected to have declined 0.5%. In May, Retail Sales rose by 1.2% (revised from 1.1%)

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah holds gains as manufacturing PMI expands in July
item.description: USD/IDR remains subdued for the fourth successive day, trading around 18,040 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair experiences notable downside pressure as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) strengthens in response to encouraging domestic economic indicators.

item.title: Japanese Yen jumps as US-Japan confirm joint intervention, hint further action
item.description: The USD/JPY pair tumbles to near 156.45 during the early European trading hours on Monday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) climbs amid speculation that Japanese authorities may have intervened to prop up the currency again after coordinated action between the US and Japan last week.

item.title: Asian stocks trade mixed as AI-led selloff and Yen rally counter Iran optimism
item.description: Asian shares were mixed at the start of a new week as losses in South Korea's KOSPI and Japan's Nikkei 225 counter improving risk sentiment due to easing Middle East tensions.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Breaks below 179.50 as bearish bias prevails
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around 179.40 during the Asian hours on Monday. The currency cross is extending a bearish near-term tone as price holds beneath both the nine-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Gains traction above 1.1500, while remaining constrained below 100-day SMA
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory near 1.1535 during the early European trading hours on Monday, bolstered by improved risk sentiment.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises above $58.00 on renewed US-Iran peace talks
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) rises after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around $58.20 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: More pain likely if fails to hold $77
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, holds onto early losses, trading 7.6% lower at around $78.60 during the Asian trading session on Monday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index weakens below 100.00 as Trump says new Iran talks would begin Monday
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 99.70 in the Asian trading hours on Monday. The DXY declines amid improved risk sentiment.

item.title: Canadian Dollar drifts lower as falling oil prices counter weak USD amid Iran hopes
item.description: The USD/CAD pair kicks off the new week on a positive note, though it lacks bullish conviction and remains confined within Friday's broader range. Spot prices currently trade around the 1.4030 region, up less than 0.10% for the day amid mixed fundamental cues.

item.title: Japan's Katayama says no comment on whether there was FX intervention on Monday
item.description: Japan's Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Monday that she has no comment on whether there was foreign exchange (FX) intervention today, Reuters reported.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains stronger following China’s RatingDog Manufacturing PMI data
item.description: AUD/USD depreciates after opening at a bullish gap, remaining in the positive territory and trading around 0.7030 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: New Zealand holds gains near 0.5900 despite weaker China PMI data
item.description: The NZD/USD pair holds positive ground near 0.5890 during the Asian trading hours on Monday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) remains firm despite the downbeat Chinese economic data.

item.title: Australian Dollar languishes near April low as joint US-Japan intervention lifts Yen
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross turns lower for the fifth straight day after a modest uptick to the 111.20 region on Monday and drops to its lowest level since early April during the Asian session.
